property_summary: For any caller paying exactly TICKET_AMOUNT to play(), the contract's pot after play() is never zero in the reference implementation when random != 0 (i.e., if the round does not pay out the winner, pot retains the added ticket); the mutant that resets pot to 0 immediately breaks this by making pot zero after some plays.
change_summary: Inserted an extra pot reset to 0 immediately after incrementing pot, changing pot observed after play.
